comments.value: Hi! The beta you mention has now gone live, and indeed includes some fixes to how the Here menu updates. Is this bug still happening on 2024.1.1 or later versions?

@{62b61f8ec938a62475e4cd14|full_name} Sorry that it's taken me some time to reply, I don't exactly go looking for instances where blocked people are so it took some time for it to arise.

It appears to be fixed, people who I have blocking situations with are appearing in the menu consistently now.

I will note though that there is one small bug where it is not remembering if you've collapsed the "blocked users" category or not. If you collapse it and then close your quick menu and then return to it, it can get disjointed from its visual state and appear as collapsed (the triangle is pointing right instead of down), yet it is not *actually* collapsed. Attached is an example image.

As a few extras:

- You can "match eye height" and "gift VRC+" and "invite to group" with users you have blocked or have blocked you. These buttons probably shouldn't exist when looking at the profile of someone who is blocking you or who you have blocked (in fact I know of instances where people have harassed others by buying them VRC+ while blocked). In fact, all buttons other than "unblock user" and "vote to kick" should be hidden imho (and you should be able to start a vote kick on blocked users, currently it does not work if you have someone blocked, not sure if this is a bug or a design decision by VRC).

- I noticed that when people join an instance, and you are the instance owner, they can momentarily appear as "users blocking you". Or at least they used to, I'm not sure if that is still the case. Not sure if that has something to do with how the client detects if someone is blocking you or not, or if there's anything to be done about it really.

- I've noticed that now anytime you press shift in the quick menu (to temporarily hide your quick menu and use your desktop reticle as a select tool), a pop-up appears saying "interaction mode set to direct touch". I'm not sure if it's meant to throw a prompt every time you press shift, seems a little verbose, just figured I'd point it out.

I've got some stuff unrelated to UI to report but probably need to make separate issues for those (I've noticed that if you jump while standing still while crouching or prone, you get locked in place until you land, but if you do it while standing you can change direction in midair as you'd expect).

None of these are that big of a deal but figured I'd just let you know. Maybe I should make separate cannys for some of these.

Thanks!

@{5eae36318b39a05c07a0d6cd|full_name}: Thanks for the detailed investigation and response! If at all possible, creating separate cannys for all of these would make tracking these a lot easier from our side.

I will close this issue specifically then, since it appears fixed in the latest update, and we can take care of the other mentioned issues on their own.

details:
When two people have each other blocked, there's a bit of weirdness about how VRChat deals with that in terms of showing them in the "here" tab.

As far as I can tell, whether or not they'll appear as "blocked" in your "here" tab is some sort of race condition or something. I believe it was probably similar reasons as to why the avatars of people who have me blocked would sometimes appear for me when they obviously shouldn't (I haven't run into that particular issue in quite a long while now, thankfully). I think it might be the same type of situation except now it's just affecting the "here" tab entry.

Sometimes blocked persons in the instance will properly appear there. Other times the "blocked" category will appear, but nothing will be listed under it.

As far as I know, the intended behavior for this scenario would be for both persons to be able to see each other's presence in the "blocked" section of the "here" tab.

Not that I fully agree with this behavior. For me this just encouraged me to block back all the people who have me blocked so that I can see that when they're in an instance with me at a glance. So I think the current behavior just encourages people to block back people who block them. But that's more of a social philiosophy problem and this isn't an opinion piece, so I'll stop with that here.

Anyway, point being, the client handles 2-way block situations in a kinda buggy manner, and figured I'd report it.

I know the current beta has a ton of bugfixes but I don't use beta, so I guess I'll leave a comment on whether or not I see it still occurring when it goes live.

Thanks.
title: [1393] When two people have each other blocked, whether or not they will correctly appear in the "here" tab to each other appears to be a coin toss.
